post.description:
Records an idempotent acknowledgement for a currently active derived critical event.
The request body must be empty; tenant and actor identity are derived from the verified
JWT bearer token only (no client-supplied tenant_id, user_id, or acknowledged_by).
The gateway validates that `eventId` matches a currently derived critical event for the
authenticated tenant before persisting acknowledgement state in the read model.
Repeating the request returns HTTP 200 with the original acknowledgement (first ack wins).

parameters.description: Opaque deterministic event identifier from `ControlTowerEvent.id` (32 lowercase hex characters).
parameters.name: eventId

200.description: Acknowledgement recorded (or returned idempotently if already acknowledged)

derived event, or cross-tenant probe — no existence leak).
